verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a DevSecOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting to disable telemetry, usage tracking or service ping. Self-hosting and the commit-email visibility complaint are a different privacy topic and a user-side workaround, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
